name: Home Assistant
description: Connect MIRA to your Home Assistant instance: read sensor state and control devices by asking MIRA. Exposes read + control tools backed by the HA REST API, plus a status panel.

config_schema.label: Home Assistant URL
config_schema.help: Your HA base URL with no trailing slash, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123

config_schema.label: Long-Lived Access Token
config_schema.help: In Home Assistant: your profile → Security → Long-Lived Access Tokens → Create Token.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Get the current state and attributes of one Home Assistant entity, e.g. sensor.living_room_temperature or light.kitchen. Returns the HA state JSON.

entity_id.description: The entity id, e.g. light.kitchen or sensor.outdoor_temperature.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List every Home Assistant entity and its current state. Use this to discover entity ids before reading or controlling them.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Control a device by calling a Home Assistant service, e.g. domain=light service=turn_on entity_id=light.kitchen, or domain=switch service=toggle. Returns the entities that changed.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, climate, cover, media_player.

service.description: Service name, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle, set_temperature.

entity_id.description: The target entity id, e.g. light.kitchen.
